```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load setup script
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("scripts", "load-data.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "overview.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "KPIs.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "KPIs_2.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "communities.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "map.R"), echo = FALSE)

```

This **internal dashboard** serves as the comprehensive resource for monitoring Collaboratory's key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics. Designed to streamline data-driven decision making, it enables the Secretariat to assess progress against targets, identify trends, and gain actionable insights into platform growth and performance. All visualizations and metrics are **weekly updated** with the latest data, ensuring that figures can be directly incorporated into presentations, reports, and strategic communications when needed.

# Overview

As of **`r current_month_date`**, Collaboratory has a total of **`r count_cop` communities of practice** and **`r total_users` members** connecting from **`r n_distinct(IP_address$COUNTRY[!is.na(IP_address$COUNTRY) & !is.na(IP_address$who_region)])` countries**. Collaboratory members come from **50+ different institutions** globally.

Over the past month, **`r users_joined_last_month`** new members have joined the Collaboratory.

# Key Performance Indicators

Collaboratory **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** provide a standardized framework to monitor and evaluate progress. KPIs meeting current targets are shown in green. You can see further trends and breakdowns of each key indicator in the subsequent report sections by clicking on the square and hover over details to view definitions and targets:
